title: Design System: VapourSynth WebAssembly — Broadcast Mixer

display.purpose: The single page statement line — h1 only.

label.purpose: Uppercase engraved field labels and node-info keys (0.1em letter-spacing).

body.purpose: Lede prose (max-width 46rem), detail values, summaries, runtime status.

code.purpose: Verbatim script code in bus nodes (0.66rem) and the .vpy editor (0.78rem, tab-size 2).

caption.purpose: Panel indexes, units, screen captions, file tags, keycap glyphs.

shadows.name: panel-drop
shadows.purpose: Resting depth under every equipment panel.

shadows.name: frame-drop
shadows.purpose: Deep shadow under the rendered canvas inside the Program monitor.

shadows.name: screen-vignette
shadows.purpose: Recessed glass of the monitor screen.

shadows.name: route-ring
shadows.purpose: Amber seat ring on the selected bus node — the only colored shadow.

shadows.name: lamp-halo
shadows.purpose: Glow halo around lit status lamps; white 5% when idle, red wash on error.

motion.name: ease-quick
motion.purpose: State transitions: bus node border/background/box-shadow, Run button filter/transform.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Rendering state lamp animation (output + runtime status).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: all animations and transitions disabled
motion.purpose: Mandatory: the pulse and every 130ms transition are suppressed.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single column stack in DOM order: monitor → signal bus → inspector → script → diagnostics; bus links rotate vertical with amber triangle heads.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Hide the BROWSER BUILD tag and keycap hints.

components.name: Run Button
components.description: The single amber-filled action: runs the script record. Disabled until the worker is ready.
components.css: .ds-run-button{display:inline-flex;min-height:2.4rem;align-items:center;gap:0.6rem;border:1px solid #f0b055;border-radius:0.35rem;padding:0.45rem 0.7rem 0.45rem 0.9rem;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6ba58,#eaa33c);color:#201505;cursor:pointer;font:600 0.78rem/1 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:0.06em;transition:filter 130ms ease,transform 130ms ease}.ds-run-button:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.07)}.ds-run-button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-run-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f6ba58;outline-offset:3px}.ds-run-button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:0.4;filter:saturate(0.25)}.ds-kbd{border:1px solid rgba(32,21,5,0.35);border-radius:0.25rem;padding:0.12rem 0.3rem;background:rgba(32,21,5,0.12);color:#201505;font:400 0.64rem/1 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace}

components.name: Signal Bus Node
components.description: Signature selectable stage card (Source / Invert / Program Output) with lamp and verbatim code; amber-lit when pressed.
components.css: .ds-bus-node{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.42rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);border-radius:0.4rem;padding:0.75rem 0.9rem;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1d1f25,#17181d);color:#e8e6e2;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;font:400 0.66rem/1.5 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;transition:border-color 130ms ease,background 130ms ease,box-shadow 130ms ease}.ds-bus-node:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.26)}.ds-bus-node:hover .ds-bus-lamp{background:#8b919b}.ds-bus-node:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eaa33c;outline-offset:2px}.ds-bus-name{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.55rem;color:#e8e6e2;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.13em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-bus-lamp{width:0.46rem;height:0.46rem;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:50%;background:#555b64;box-shadow:0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}.ds-bus-code{color:#838a94;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-bus-node[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#eaa33c;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(234,163,60,0.09),rgba(234,163,60,0.03)),#17181d;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(234,163,60,0.16)}.ds-bus-node[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-bus-lamp{background:#eaa33c;box-shadow:0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(234,163,60,0.16)}.ds-bus-node[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-bus-name{color:#f4e3c8}

components.name: Numeric Field
components.description: Inspector parameter row: engraved uppercase label, right-aligned numeric value, slate unit.
components.html: px
components.css: .ds-numeric-field{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;align-items:center;gap:0.55rem;padding:0.6rem 1rem}.ds-numeric-field label{color:#a3a8b0;font:600 0.68rem/1 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-numeric-field input{width:6.2rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);border-radius:0.3rem;padding:0.38rem 0.5rem;background:#0e0f12;color:#e8e6e2;font:400 0.78rem/1.2 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;text-align:right;caret-color:#eaa33c}.ds-numeric-field input:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.24)}.ds-numeric-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eaa33c;outline-offset:2px;border-color:#eaa33c}.ds-unit{color:#838a94;font:400 0.64rem/1 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace}

components.name: Output State Pill
components.description: Program monitor status capsule: lamp dot plus state label; ready = amber halo, error = red halo, rendering = pulse.
components.css: .ds-status-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);border-radius:999px;padding:0.32rem 0.6rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);color:#a3a8b0;font:400 0.68rem/1 ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace}.ds-lamp{width:0.44rem;height:0.44rem;border-radius:50%;background:#555b64;box-shadow:0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}.ds-status-pill[data-state="ready"] .ds-lamp{background:#eaa33c;box-shadow:0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(234,163,60,0.16)}.ds-status-pill[data-state="rendering"] .ds-lamp{background:#eaa33c;box-shadow:0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(234,163,60,0.16);animation:pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}.ds-status-pill[data-state="error"] .ds-lamp{background:#f07c72;box-shadow:0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(240,124,114,0.15)}@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:0.35}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.ds-status-pill *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
This is a broadcast production desk, not a code editor with a preview attached. The workspace is a night control room: graphite equipment surfaces stacked in a rack, a dominating Program monitor, a literal signal bus carrying Source → Invert → Program Output, a focused parameter inspector, and the .vpy script as a technical record rather than the primary composition. Signal amber is the only active-route accent; everything at rest is graphite, hairline-divided, and lit like an idle broadcast suite awaiting a take.

Density is high and uniform. Every label is a small uppercase, letter-spaced engraving; every real value, expression, and code sample is verbatim monospace text on a dark field. Depth comes from tonal layering of graphite surfaces and dark ambient shadow, never from color. The world is deliberately quiet: no gradients of hue, no display faces, no decorative illustration — the frame output and the amber route are the only things allowed to glow.

Motion is a state language, not decoration: 130ms ease transitions for route selection, a single pulse animation for "rendering" states, everything suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion. Keyboard operation is first-class — every bus stage is a real button, focus is always a 2px amber ring, and status is announced with aria-live.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite equipment racks: dark neutral surfaces (#131418 family) with 1px white hairlines (7.5% / 14% alpha) and 0.5rem-radius corners.
Signal amber (#eaa33c) as the sole active-route accent — selection, route links, lit lamps, focus rings, carets, and the Run action.
Monospace-only typography, from the 0.64rem captions to the clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 2.1rem) statement line.
A visible signal bus: three selectable stage nodes joined by amber arrows, not abstract tabs.
Status lamps everywhere: small circles with translucent halos that switch idle gray → amber → error red.
Flat at rest, dark ambient shadows only; amber appears as a ring or halo, never a glow field.

rules.name: The Signal Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is the sole active-route accent. Its legal appearances are: the selected bus node (border, lamp, ring, name), bus links, lit status lamps, focus outlines, the caret, text selection, and the Run action. Anything else in amber is a routing violation.

rules.name: The Fail Red Rule
rules.body: Red means "the run failed" — nothing else. Idle and ready states are gray and amber; red never decorates, it only reports.

rules.name: The Monospace-Only Rule
rules.body: Every glyph on the surface is the mono stack — headings, labels, values, and code alike. A proportional or display face is off-world; when something must stand out, it earns size, weight, or amber instead.

rules.name: The Engraving Rule
rules.body: Labels are engraved, not written: uppercase, 600 weight, 0.1em+ letter-spacing, and never larger than 0.72rem. Title case and sentence case belong to code and to the page statement only.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Panels are flat at rest. The only allowed shadows are the dark ambient panel/frame drops and inner highlights; the only colored "shadow" in the system is the amber route ring and lamp halos on the active route.

dos: Do use Signal Amber (#eaa33c) for the active route and only the active route: selected bus node, bus links, lit lamps, focus rings, carets, selection, and the Run button.
Do keep every equipment module graphite: Panel #131418, Raised #17181d, Highlight #1d1f25, with 1px hairlines (7.5% white resting, 14% white interactive).
Do give every status indicator the lamp treatment: 0.4–0.46rem circle with a 0.18rem halo, switching idle gray (#555b64) → amber → red.
Do engrave labels: uppercase, 600 weight, 0.1em+ letter-spacing, never above 0.72rem.
Do set focus visibly everywhere with the 2px amber outline at 2px offset (the Run button at 3px, the script editor as an inset 1px amber shadow).
Do write real code verbatim in monospace — bus node captions and the .vpy record — and keep tab-size: 2 in the editor.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the pulse and all 130ms transitions switch off.
Do announce state changes with aria-live and keep DOM order equal to visual order.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue. Red (#f07c72) exists only for failed runs; idle, ready, and active states are gray and amber.
Don't paint large amber fields — the Run button is the only amber fill, and its label is Amber Ink (#201505).
Don't use shadows for elevation beyond the dark ambient panel drop and the monitor's inset vignette; amber depth is a 1px ring and lamp halos only.
Don't add display or proportional fonts — the mono stack is the entire type system.
Don't invent signal-bus stages. The bus is exactly Source → Invert → Program Output, each a real supported VapourSynth operation rendered as its actual code.
Don't change the corner language: 0.3rem controls, 0.4rem bus nodes, 0.5rem panels, 999px status pills.
Don't smooth the frame canvas — image-rendering: pixelated is the honest rendering of RGBA8 worker output.
